Backup Verifier

Verify every backup is current.

What it does

Runs read-only checks across the _Backups folder - skills, project backups, archives, scheduled-task snapshots - and outputs a drift report, surfacing stale skill packages as click-installable .skill files.

When to use it

After a batch of skill or project changes, or whenever you are unsure a backup is current.

How to trigger it

"verify all backups"

"are my backups up to date"

"backup drift check"
